test_cases.title: Home shows a card for every section
acs: DERIVED: Home shows the cards System Administration, Manage Contracts, Manage Schemes, Distributions, Test Consultant, Assessor and Results Sign-off (Navigations folder, MasterPage)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134). Only the Admin role is ticked for this user; the menus are compared with the Navigations pictures.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Home.aspx.
Read the section cards.
Compare the card names.
steps.expected: They are System Administration, Manage Contracts, Manage Schemes, Distributions, Test Consultant, Assessor and Results Sign-off.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Do not click any card.

test_cases.title: A section menu lists its items
acs: DERIVED: Each section menu lists the items of the Navigations pictures: System Administration 11 items, Manage Contracts 4 (Invoice Generation needs the Generate Invoices role), Manage Schemes 7, Distributions 3 (data/nav-items.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134). Only the Admin role is ticked for this user; the menus are compared with the Navigations pictures.
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted.

steps.action: Open Home and click the section card in the row.
Read the menu on the left.
Compare with the items in the row.
steps.expected: The items and their order match.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Do not click any item.
